bbb.script4.cod.00004ed4: HO!!! You make me queen... Me think you a prince...
bbb.script4.cod.00004f1e: Me not know which way to hang it!...
bbb.script4.cod.00004f36: You tangle thoughts in my head...
bbb.script4.cod.00004fd8: Speaking of which, Commander darling, you'll have to loosen up...
bbb.script4.cod.00004ff4: calm down, calm down... So, the snitch?...
bbb.script4.cod.0000502e: Bionium... MMM! Very good... Me feel in great shape...
bbb.script4.cod.0000507f: Technology... BROWN GOODS!!! Leave quickly, or me turn red with anger...
bbb.script4.cod.000050a5: COMMANDER, that wasn't a good idea... She'll hold it against you for sure...
bbb.script4.cod.000050ed: A guitar... Wonderful! Izwalito will play beautiful ballads... THANK YOU!
bbb.script4.cod.00005111: COMMANDER... She's in for a disappointment. Izwalito dreams of becoming a ROCK AND ROLL STAR...
bbb.script4.cod.0000518e: Perfume... Me hot all over. Me like full-moon night, MMM...
bbb.script4.cod.0000520b: A TV decoder... YIPPEEE!!! Me able to watch TRASHLANDO Watch...
bbb.script4.cod.0000525a: Food... MMM, YUM YUM!!! Me watch my figure. HEE! HEE!...
bbb.script4.cod.00005282: Yes, COMMANDER, she does have a lovely figure...
bbb.script4.cod.000052b6: Medicine... You good COMMANDER, you soothe my liver, my intestine, my gallbladder, my...
bbb.script4.cod.000052e0: COMMANDER! Let's not stay here! She might be contagious...
bbb.script4.cod.0000531b: WEAPONS... BAH! Me have very good kitchen knives. But leave them, might come in handy...
bbb.script4.cod.0000536d: An optical device. Very good! Me able to watch Izwalito a little more closely...
bbb.script4.cod.000053ae: Energy... Me able to do big spring cleaning. THANK YOU!
bbb.script4.cod.000053e4: A ring... OH! Is it for me, COMMANDER? THANK YOU!
bbb.script4.cod.00005402: There you go, you've made another one happy... That COMMANDER...
bbb.script4.cod.00005472: Culture... OW!!! Me have very bad headache... Me study later...
bbb.script4.cod.0000549e: COMMANDER, and we wanted to elevate his mind...
bbb.script4.cod.000054d5: Writing... You want to make me great writer. THANK YOU...
bbb.script4.cod.000054f3: COMMANDER, she's dreaming... Let's not get carried away...
bbb.script4.cod.00005521: A SHIP... OH! Me choose color?
bbb.script4.cod.0000553f: COMMANDER, we give her a ship and all she notices is the color...
bbb.script4.cod.00005580: A treaty... THANK YOU! Me no longer want little Izwal going to war...
bbb.script4.cod.000055d1: Gifts... THANK YOU! You be most handsome, most kind...
bbb.script4.cod.00005609: Which object would you like to give, Commander?
